reapack.name: RefLab.jsfx
reapack.desc: RefLab - Multi-track referencing (spectrum, LUFS, loudness match, loops, band solo)

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Vitesse de mesure du spectre reglable : rapide, moyen, lent, tres lent, moyenne infinie - Bouton VITESSE, clic droit / touche R : remise a zero de la moyenne - Deux nouveaux parametres assignables : vitesse suivante, reset moyenne spectre - Fonctionne avec le Todoroki Companion (dossier references, actualisation)

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Les references, boucles et la reference selectionnee sont memorisees DANS LE PROJET (via le Todoroki Companion), meme quand RefLab est dans le Monitoring FX - Sauvegarde interne du plugin plus robuste (ordre de chargement, version du format) - Spectre : nouvelles vitesses ULTRA LENT (15 s) et GLACIAL (45 s), glissement doux en dB, gel automatique quand la lecture s'arrete - Isolation de bandes facon ISOL8 : 5 bandes (crossovers Linkwitz-Riley, somme a plat), solo exclusif / cumulable, crossovers deplacables sur le spectre - Modes d'ecoute : stereo, mono, side, gauche, droite (sur le mix ET les references) - Courbe d'ecart lisible : centrage sur l'ecart moyen, echelle auto ou fixe, lissage dedie - Tous les nouveaux reglages assignables en MIDI (Param > Learn) et via des actions

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Everything in English: interface, parameters, menus, actions and documentation - Spectrum speeds simplified: FAST, MEDIUM, SLOW, VERY SLOW, INFINITE AVERAGE (ULTRA SLOW and GLACIAL removed; SLOW keeps the smooth dB glide) - Note: the reference actions were renamed; re-assign any shortcut you made in 1.3

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Spectrum speeds: FAST, MEDIUM, SLOW (smooth dB glide), INFINITE AVERAGE (VERY SLOW removed) - Difference curve smoothing: 1/48, 1/24, 1/12, 1/6, 1/3 or 1 octave - Actions renamed with the Todoroki_ prefix (re-assign the shortcuts made before)

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - VELOCITY target per slot: play a fixed velocity (VEL SENS 0%) or follow the drummer's dynamics around it (VEL SENS 100%), clipped to 127 - Clicking an empty slot opens the browser directly - Folder browser (Element / Instrument / mic), search across the whole library, >4000 files - English UI - Time-based drum envelope (attack / hold / decay / curve), anti-click fades, voice limit

reapack.name: Todoroki_Portable Backup.lua
reapack.desc: Todoroki Portable Backup - save, restore and clear the settings of a portable REAPER

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - First version: replaces backup_reaper.bat / save_reaper.bat / restore_reaper.bat - Pick what to save or restore (all selected by default) and where - Includes RefLab references, RS Trig library and the User folders of NAM, Vital, Decent Sampler - Restore waits for REAPER to quit, copies everything back, then relaunches REAPER - Clean backups: delete old temporary / archived backups - Minimal square toolbar icons (100 / 150 / 200 %), installed into Data/toolbar_icons on first run

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - New: Todoroki_Portable Clear user data - empty your personal data (settings, shortcuts, templates, RefLab references, RS Trig library, plugin User folders) so the next person gets a clean REAPER and restores their own backup. Saves a copy to the archive first (on by default). Portable mode, ReaPack and the Todoroki_Portable actions are always kept. - Poise removed from the plugin list

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Actions pour tous les reglages de RefLab (assignables clavier / MIDI) - Nouvelles actions : vitesse du spectre suivante, reset de la moyenne du spectre - Module pour le Todoroki Companion (dossier references, liste mise a jour en direct)

reapack.name: Todoroki_RS Trig Kit Builder.lua
reapack.desc: RS Trig Kit Builder - TCI import, kit builder and library for RS Trig Sampler

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Files renamed with the Todoroki_ prefix, like the other scripts of this repository - New: RS Trig TCI Converter (browser page) to convert a whole Trigger library folder, same decoder and organisation, writes straight into Data/RSampler (Chrome / Edge) or a ZIP - Import Slate Trigger 2 .tci files (bit-exact decoding, velocity layers and round robins kept) - Automatic library organisation: <Element>/<Instrument>/<name>.rsk.wav - Build kits from WAV folders (V01_RR1, Vel3, name_025_01 and untagged conventions) - Unpack kits to WAV, rescan the library, demo kit installed on first run - English UI

version.author: Todoroki
version.changelog: - Scripts renamed with the Todoroki_ prefix: Todoroki_Companion, Todoroki_Companion autostart (on-off), Todoroki_Companion status and modules - If you installed the previous "Todoroki Companion" package: uninstall it in ReaPack (it is now obsolete), then run "Todoroki_Companion autostart (on-off)" once to update the startup line
